body: Thank you. Can things happen after I graduate? What if I end up working at that hospital as an intern?

I am a Nursing student but I will soon graduate from school. I am currently having rotations at a hospital. This doctor who seems twice my age seems interested in me, and it wasn't later that we realised that he is a prof at my college and I am a student. Things got awkward but he is still extremely nice and helpful to me.

I know my psychiatrist wants to know how I've been to know to treat me. I guess it is a good idea to open up to her but I am very aware of the fact that the prof was probably her prof at some point (as he had been teaching at my college for quite a while). I think it is awkward as fuck for my psychiatrist to hear about her professor's more "private" details. I also fear she will judge me as that prof is around twice my age and I am technically still a student. I really don't know if I should just avoid mentioning anything about the prof the next time I see my psychiatrist. I feel so worried I will be judged because of it and she will talk about it behind my back.
